_note: The real personas (one persona = one brand's set of accounts). 'npm run manage -- import <id>' loads a persona from here together with its content (content-manifests/<id>.json). 'id': lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Every persona needs a handle for each platform in platforms.json. 'competitors' are the accounts the warm-up sends posters to (any platform from platforms.json); 'keywords' are searched on every platform. 'pinned_comment' empty = no pinned comment. Replace the example below with your own brand.

personas.name: Example Brand
personas.bio: One short line about the product ✨
